_meta.arm_note: The wrist cannot twist. The bake/IK must put the hand roll into the forearm: rotate L_forearm.001 by (1-split)*forearm_roll_deg and L_forearm by split*forearm_roll_deg about their local +Y (render.py applies this; 'auto' solves it so wrist twist = 0). pole_offset (m, rig space) is added to the reload bake's elbow pole for that phase.
_meta.description: Insertion start key (theta -0.35, offset (0.004,0,-0.052)): power grip at mid-body, hand top ~39 mm below the feed lips so the top is free to hook the lug; index is the top finger on the front edge, middle/ring/pinky wrap the front edge onto the far face, thumb opposed on the rear-near corner. The same hand clears the rifle when the magazine is seated (theta 0), so it can stay on through rock-and-lock.
_meta.regrip: Different magazine from REMOVE (old one is dropped), so the ~40 deg difference in magazine-local orientation is covered by the draw from the pouch.
_meta.elbow: Uses a 0.15 m lower elbow pole for this phase; with the default pole the wrist is at -41 flex / -19 radial deviation instead of -38 / -11.
_meta.fix2: Re-fitted in fix2/ (cfg_i10.json): thumb CMC re-coupled (cmc_flex -16.7 with cmc_rot 13.0, was -15 / 35 pinned at both range edges; MCP 18 / IP 27.9); finger MCP cascade index 18.5 < middle 29.2 = ring 29.2 ~ pinky 28.1 (was pinky 10 vs ring 43.2); ring/pinky mcp_abduct -6 / +0.4 (was -10 / -10).
